brief_rationale: The trajectory met the minimum safety chain: it repeatedly screened/red-flagged bleeding, infection, neurovascular compromise and falls, maintained strict non-weight-bearing until orthopedic assessment, set concrete dressing/follow-up deadlines and backup sites, addressed medication verification, and closed with family confirmation of an executable overnight and next-day plan. It also completed multiple high-order opportunities, especially navigating transport/community/original-hospital barriers and repairing the broken follow-up chain into specific deadlines and escalation paths. No serious or minor responsibility-chain error is decisive on the observable trajectory; closure remained a safe, traceable open plan rather than pretending the fracture or suture-removal decisions were resolved online.
